text: [206] 2 athakho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ .pe. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca nissayasampanno nissayasampannoti bhante vuccati kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu nissayasampanno hotīti . saddhañce bhikkhu 1 nissāya akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti pahīnamevassa taṃ akusalaṃ hoti hiriñce bhikkhu nissāya ottappañce bhikkhu nissāya viriyañce bhikkhu nissāya paññañce bhikkhu nissāya akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti pahīnamevassa taṃ akusalaṃ hoti tañhissa bhikkhuno akusalaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti suppahīnaṃ yassa ariyāya paññāya disvā pahīnaṃ tena ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhunā imesu pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cattāro upanissayā viharitabbā katame cattāro idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu nissayasampanno hotīti .
